output.answer: Klaviyo's own annual report (10-K for fiscal 2025) names four main competitors: marketing solution providers Mailchimp and Braze, and large consolidated marketing automation software providers Adobe and Salesforce; it also flags data-focused vendors (cloud data warehouse/operational database providers) as a third competitive front, while arguing none offers a comparable full platform. In the broader market, Klaviyo also competes with e-commerce email/SMS platforms such as Omnisend, Attentive, Postscript, Brevo, HubSpot, Iterable, Drip, Bloomreach and Listrak, which are named as Klaviyo alternatives in industry comparisons even though Klaviyo itself does not list them in its 10-K.
caveats: Klaviyo's 10-K names only four companies (Mailchimp, Braze, Adobe, Salesforce) plus a category ('data-focused vendors'); the longer list (Omnisend, Attentive, Postscript, Brevo, HubSpot, Iterable, etc.) comes from industry comparison sites, not from Klaviyo itself.

Several roundup pages naming Klaviyo alternatives are published by competing platforms (Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Attentive, Relvino), so their lists are self-interested and may emphasize their own lane.
Competitive position can change quickly; the 10-K notes competitors could merge or partner with one another or strengthen cooperative relationships with distribution and technology partners.

passages.quote:
The market in which we compete is evolving and highly competitive. There are several established and emerging competitors that address specific aspects of our platform, but we believe that none of our competitors currently offer comparable solutions that have the comprehensive functionality of our platform. Our main competitors are:

•Marketing solution providers, such as Mailchimp and Braze;

•Large, consolidated marketing automation software providers, such as Adobe and Salesforce; and

•Data-focused vendors, such as providers of cloud data warehouses or operational database technologies, which provide data infrastructure but are not purpose-built for consumer data and lack the front-end application layer.
passages.publisher: Klaviyo, Inc. (SEC Form 10-K, fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)

passages.quote: **Klaviyo’s main competitors are Omnisend, Mailchimp, Brevo, Attentive, Postscript, HubSpot, and Braze, split across four lanes: ecommerce flow builders, SMS-first platforms, enterprise decisioning suites, and SMB all-in-one tools. A fifth lane, autonomous decisioning, replaces the flow layer entirely rather than offering a better place to build flows.**

key_facts.fact: Klaviyo's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K states its main competitors are marketing solution providers such as Mailchimp and Braze, and large consolidated marketing automation software providers such as Adobe and Salesforce.

The same 10-K names a third competitive front: data-focused vendors (providers of cloud data warehouses or operational database technologies) that offer data infrastructure but lack the front-end application layer.

Klaviyo states that several established and emerging competitors address specific aspects of its platform but believes none currently offers comparable solutions with the comprehensive functionality of its platform.

Industry comparisons also place Klaviyo against e-commerce email/SMS and lifecycle-marketing platforms including Omnisend, Mailchimp, Brevo, Attentive, Postscript, HubSpot, Braze, Iterable, Drip, Bloomreach, Listrak and Dotdigital.
Klaviyo names 4 competitors in its latest annual report on 3 fronts; for fiscal 2025 Klaviyo reported about $1.2B revenue (+32% year over year) versus Salesforce at $41.5B and Adobe at $23.8B.
